skills.name: attribute-creation
skills.description: Guides you step-by-step through defining a calculated attribute (dimension) on a Honeydew entity. Covers SQL expression building and pushes to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
headings: After Creation/Update: Display the UI Link
skills.description_zh: 逐步在 Honeydew 实体上定义计算属性/维度，构建 SQL 表达式并通过 MCP 推送到 Honeydew。

skills.name: context-item-creation
skills.description: Guides you through creating context items — instructions, skills, knowledge pointers, and memory events — that give the AI analyst persistent knowledge about your organization. Covers when to create each type, naming conventions, folder organization, and the hard boundary between context (rules and procedures) and the semantic layer (logic and calculations).
headings: THE HARD BOUNDARY: Context vs. Semantic Layer
When to use the Semantic Layer instead
What context items ARE good for
Before creating: where does this context belong?
After Creation/Update: Display the UI Link
skills.description_zh: 创建让 AI 分析师长期理解组织的上下文项，包括指令、skill、知识指针和记忆事件，说明类型选择、命名与目录，以及规则流程和语义层计算之间的边界。

skills.name: conversation-review
skills.description: Use when a semantic/context layer curator wants to review past analysis conversations in bulk, categorize user feedback into actionable improvement areas, and apply targeted changes to the semantic model or context layer. Covers the full workflow from collecting conversations and classifying feedback through to creating action items and applying them on a branch.
headings: 1.2 Read the full conversation when needed
Phase 4: Apply Changes on a Branch
4.5 Review branch history and open a PR
skills.description_zh: 批量复核历史分析对话，将用户反馈分类为语义模型/上下文的改进事项，并在分支上应用针对性调整。

skills.name: domain-creation
skills.description: Guides you through creating a Honeydew domain — a governance object that scopes entity/field visibility and applies mandatory filters — ideal for setting up contexts for deep analysis. Also covers domain hierarchy — extending parent domains, inheritance and merge rules, multiple inheritance, and removing inherited items.
headings: After Creation/Update: Display the UI Link
skills.description_zh: 创建 Honeydew domain，以实体/字段可见范围和强制过滤治理分析上下文，支持父域扩展、继承合并、多继承及移除继承项。

skills.name: entity-creation
skills.description: Guides you through defining a new Honeydew entity from a data warehouse source — covering source type, granularity key, and initial attribute mapping — then pushes to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
headings: After Creation: Display the UI Link
After Validating: Hand Off to relation-creation
skills.description_zh: 从数仓来源定义 Honeydew 实体，确定来源类型、粒度键和初始属性映射，并通过 MCP 推送。

skills.name: filtering
skills.description: Use when the user needs to filter data — whether in a structured query, a metric aggregation, or an attribute expression. Covers filter syntax, date handling, and best practices.
skills.description_zh: 为结构化查询、指标聚合或属性表达式设置数据过滤，说明过滤语法、日期处理和实践要点。

skills.name: metric-creation
skills.description: Guides you step-by-step through defining a business metric (aggregation) on a Honeydew entity. Covers SQL expression building and pushes to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
headings: After Creation/Update: Display the UI Link
skills.description_zh: 逐步在 Honeydew 实体上定义业务聚合指标，编写 SQL 表达式并通过 MCP 推送。

skills.name: model-exploration
skills.description: Use when exploring Honeydew semantic layer, discovering entities/fields, setting up workspace and branch context, or running structured queries to spot-check field values. Any question about the data itself — "why", "how", trends, root cause, anything needing multiple steps — belongs to the query skill's deep analysis, including when already mid-exploration. For creating metrics use metric-creation skill. For creating attributes use attribute-creation skill.
headings: Scope: The Model, Not The Data
skills.description_zh: 探索 Honeydew 语义层实体和字段，设置工作区/分支并用结构化查询抽查字段值；趋势、根因和多步骤分析交给 query，新增指标/属性交给对应创建 skill。

skills.name: query-debugging
skills.description: Use when the user wants to review or inspect past query executions in Honeydew — what ran, from which client (BI tools, SQL interface, MCP, deep analysis), the semantic definition or compiled SQL behind a run, who ran it and when — and to debug failures. Uses the list_query_history MCP tool. For running new queries or analysis use the query skill.
skills.description_zh: 通过 list_query_history 检查 Honeydew 历史执行，查看客户端、语义定义/编译 SQL、执行者与时间，并诊断失败；新查询和分析交给 query。

skills.name: query
skills.description: Use when the user wants to query or analyze data through the Honeydew semantic layer — including natural language analysis questions, deep multi-step investigations, and structured queries. For model/field discovery use the model-exploration skill.
headings: Poll loop — report to user after each call that has new content
skills.description_zh: 通过 Honeydew 语义层执行自然语言问数、深入多步骤分析和结构化查询；模型与字段发现交给 model-exploration。

skills.name: relation-creation
skills.description: Guides you through defining a relationship between two Honeydew entities — covering join type, direction, cross-filtering, and connection method — then pushes the updated entity YAML to Honeydew via the MCP tools.
headings: Primary: update_object on the Source Entity
After Creation/Update: Display the UI Link
skills.description_zh: 定义两个 Honeydew 实体的关联类型、方向、交叉过滤和连接方式，再通过 MCP 推送更新后的实体 YAML。

skills.name: validation
skills.description: Use after creating or modifying ANY Honeydew object (metric, attribute, entity, domain). Provides type-specific validation logic to ensure objects work correctly and return sensible results.
skills.description_zh: 在创建或修改 Honeydew 指标、属性、实体或 domain 后，按对象类型验证功能和结果合理性。

skills.name: workspace-branch
skills.description: Use when setting up workspace and branch context, switching workspaces or branches, creating or deleting branches, reviewing branch history, or creating a pull request for a working branch. This skill should be used when the user asks to "list workspaces", "switch workspace", "create a branch", "delete a branch", "switch branch", "show branch history", "create a PR", or "open a pull request" in Honeydew.
headings: Reviewing work done on a branch
Finishing development and opening a PR
skills.description_zh: 管理 Honeydew 工作区与分支上下文，支持切换、创建/删除分支、查看历史以及为工作分支创建 PR。
